def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    rs=[r for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==2]

    r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if grid[r][c] not in (0,2):
          if r0<=r<=r1: # marker row cuts horizontal across full grid
            for x in range(w): out[r][x]=2
          if c0<=c<=c1: # marker column cuts vertically across full grid
            for y in range(h): out[y][c]=2
    return out
